entries.response: Full response. +5 to ritual roll. Entity may add its own conditions or expectations.
Partial response. +3 to ritual roll. Effect is noticeably weaker or slightly altered.
Minimal response. +1 to ritual roll. Result barely functions as intended.
No response. Ritual draws only on caster's residual power (treat as 2 SPI personal).
Distracted or displeased. -2 to ritual roll. Something else may notice instead.
Active rejection. Ritual fails automatically. The entity is now aware of the caster.
